acceptance_checks: A goal-level CCA judge emits, for each prose condition, a verdict carrying status, evidence, and reason, conforming to the conditions schema added earlier.
The judge receives the goal, the merged PR list, and the repository at origin/main, and is dispatched through the same adapter path as the existing pre-PR reviewer.
insufficient_evidence now blocks goal completion alongside fail, in both cmd_goal_complete and the loop stop.

A goal reproducing the observed false positive — one done task, a condition requiring a page per major feature with only one page present — does NOT reach status complete, and its report records that condition as fail or insufficient_evidence with the evidence it found.
The judge never writes an approval record and never mutates goal.completion_conditions.
Every goal fixture across scripts/test_shiki_*.sh that acquires a blocking condition verdict is updated in the same change so no suite regresses.
non_goals: Changing task-level CCA behaviour or its verdict schema.
Allowing the judge to narrow, rewrite, or reorder completion_conditions.
Allowing the judge to author any approval record.
scope: Add a goal-level CCA judge that maps each undeclared (prose) completion condition to evidence and emits a per-condition verdict, dispatched the way the existing pre-PR reviewer is. Then flip the gate so insufficient_evidence blocks completion alongside fail, and update every goal fixture across the shell suites that acquires a blocking verdict as a result.
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target . && for s in scripts/test_shiki_*.sh; do bash "$s" || exit 1; done
title: Judge prose completion conditions with a goal-level CCA and gate on insufficient evidence
